title: HALLMARK: How to Diagnose LLM Citation Verifiers and When to Deploy Them
abstract: arXiv:2607.18360v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: GPTZero found 53 NeurIPS 2025 accepted papers with hallucinated citations, and venues now screen submissions with automated reference checkers. Rule- and Large Language Model (LLM)-based verifiers are emerging, but many are released without a shared evaluation and each flags a different kind of error, so it is unclear which to trust or when to deploy them. We address this with HALLMARK (Hallucination benchmark): 2,526 BibTeX entries spanning 14 hallucination types, with per-type and diagnostic sub-test labels and further temporal, cross-domain, and real-world evaluation splits. We evaluate zero-shot and tool-augmented LLMs, a DOI-lookup baseline, and our own co-designed rule-based verifier, bibtex-updater. Verifiers can miss hallucinations and wrongly flag correct papers, so every flag still needs human review. The false positive rate (FPR) determines the review effort and thus limits deployment. translated_title: HALLMARK：如何诊断LLM引用验证器以及何时部署它们
translated_abstract: GPTZero发现有53篇NeurIPS 2025录用论文存在虚构引用，各学术会议目前正使用自动参考文献检查工具筛选投稿。基于规则和基于大语言模型（LLM）的验证器正在涌现，但许多验证器发布时缺乏统一的评估标准，且各自标记的错误类型不同，因此尚不清楚应该信任哪一个以及何时部署它们。我们通过HALLMARK（幻觉基准测试）来解决这一问题：该基准包含2,526条BibTeX条目，涵盖14种幻觉类型，带有按类型划分的标签和诊断性子测试标签，并进一步设置了时间性、跨领域和真实世界的评估划分。我们评估了零样本和工具增强的LLM、一个DOI查找基线，以及我们自己协同设计的基于规则的验证器bibtex-updater。验证器可能会遗漏幻觉引用并错误标记正确的论文，因此每个标记仍需人工审查。误报率（FPR）决定了审查工作量，从而限制了部署。被测试的模型表现出……
tldr: 提出了包含2,526条BibTeX条目、覆盖14种幻觉类型的HALLMARK基准，用于系统诊断LLM引用验证器的可靠性，并指出误报率是决定其能否实际部署的关键瓶颈。
en_tdlr: We introduce HALLMARK, a benchmark of 2,526 BibTeX entries spanning 14 hallucination types for systematically diagnosing LLM citation verifiers, revealing that the false positive rate is the key bottleneck limiting their deployment.
